author: Dalasan
quote: Resident Evil Requiem is an incredible experience and a great reminder of why this franchise is one of the best in survival horror. The atmosphere, tension, graphics, sound design, and terrifying moments make this game truly special.What I love most is how it manages to keep you on edge, making every encounter feel dangerous and every moment unpredictable. It captures the essence of Resident Evil while delivering an experience that feels fresh and **** me, a great horror game isn’t just about monsters or jump scares. It’s about creating fear, tension, and the desire to keep exploring even when everything around you feels terrifying.Resident Evil Requiem delivers that experience exceptionally well. It isn’t perfect, but it’s an outstanding game and one of the most memorable experiences in the franchise.A fantastic survival horror experience. Highly recommended!

author: Dalasan
quote: GTA VI is undoubtedly an impressive game in terms of graphics, detail, and technical quality. Rockstar has created an incredible world that feels alive and immersive. However, for me, something important is missing: the essence of what made Grand Theft Auto so special.A great game isn’t just about realistic graphics or an enormous map. It’s about freedom, personality, memorable moments, and that unique feeling that made us fall in love with the franchise.Honestly, I still find myself enjoying GTA San Andreas more. It had a special charm, a personality, and an identity that I feel GTA VI is missing.I respect the work behind GTA VI, and I understand why so many people love it, but impressive graphics alone aren’t enough to make a game **** me, GTA VI looks incredible, but it doesn’t capture the soul of the GTA I fell in love with.

author: Dalasan
quote: For me, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time is the greatest video game of all time. It’s much more than just a game; it’s an unforgettable adventure filled with magic, emotion, mystery, and **** story, soundtrack, characters, dungeons, and incredible world of Hyrule make it a truly unique experience. Even after all these years, it still has something that many modern games struggle to achieve: soul.I’ve played many incredible games, but none has ever taken the place Ocarina of Time holds in my heart. It’s not just nostalgia. It’s a masterpiece that has stood the test of time.A timeless legend and a perfect 10/10.
